<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: sans-serif; color: #eee; }
  canvas { background: #1b1f2a; border: 2px solid #444; cursor: none; max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const LEVELS = [
  [
    "1111111111",
    "1111111111",
    "2222222222",
    "2222222222",
    "3333333333"
  ],
  [
    "4400000044",
    "4441111444",
    "0222222220",
    "3303333033",
    "0333003330",
    "2202222022"
  ]
];
const COLORS = { 1: '#e74c3c', 2: '#f39c12', 3: '#2ecc71', 4: '#9b59b6' };
const HITS = { 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 4: 2 };

const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_W = 70, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_PAD = 6;
const BRICK_OFF_X = (W - (BRICK_COLS * (BRICK_W + BRICK_PAD) - BRICK_PAD)) / 2;
const BRICK_OFF_Y = 70;

const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 9 };
const ball = { r: 8, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
let bricks = [];
let score = 0, lives = 3, level = 0;
let state = 'start'; // start, playing, levelclear, gameover, win, paused
const keys = {};

function loadLevel(n) {
  bricks = [];
  LEVELS[n].forEach((row, r) => {
    [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const t = +ch;
      if (t) bricks.push({
        x: BRICK_OFF_X + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_PAD),
        y: BRICK_OFF_Y + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_PAD),
        type: t, hits: HITS[t], alive: true
      });
    });
  });
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
  ball.stuck = true;
  ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
  stickBall();
}

function stickBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
}

function launch() {
  if (!ball.stuck) return;
  const speed = 5.5 + level * 1.0;
  const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3) - Math.PI / 2;
  ball.vx = speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.vy = speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.stuck = false;
}

function newGame() {
  score = 0; lives = 3; level = 0;
  loadLevel(0);
  state = 'playing';
}

function action() {
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') newGame();
  else if (state === 'levelclear') { level++; loadLevel(level); state = 'playing'; }
  else if (state === 'playing') launch();
}

// Keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); action(); }
  if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') {
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
  }
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// Mouse
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, mx - paddle.w / 2));
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });

function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) paddle.x -= paddle.speed;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) paddle.x += paddle.speed;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  if (ball.stuck) { stickBall(); return; }

  // Sub-step movement to avoid tunneling
  const steps = Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(ball.vx), Math.abs(ball.vy)) / 4);
  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx / steps;
    ball.y += ball.vy / steps;
    if (collide()) break;
  }
}

function collide() {
  // Walls
  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Bottom: lose a life
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) state = 'gameover';
    else resetBall();
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r) {
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
    const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit));
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    const angle = clamped * (Math.PI / 3);
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    return true;
  }

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BRICK_W));
    const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BRICK_H));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= ball.r * ball.r) {
      // Decide bounce axis from penetration depth
      const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + BRICK_W - (ball.x - ball.r));
      const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + BRICK_H - (ball.y - ball.r));
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + BRICK_W / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
      } else {
        ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + BRICK_H / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
      b.hits--;
      if (b.hits <= 0) {
        b.alive = false;
        score += b.type === 4 ? 50 : (4 - b.type) * 10 + 10;
      } else {
        score += 5;
      }
      if (bricks.every(br => !br.alive)) {
        state = level + 1 < LEVELS.length ? 'levelclear' : 'win';
      }
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function drawText(text, y, size = 28, color = '#fff') {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eee';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, 32);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 32);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)), W - 16, 32);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 46); ctx.lineTo(W, 46); ctx.stroke();

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = (b.type === 4 && b.hits === 1) ? '#d7a6ec' : COLORS[b.type];
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, BRICK_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, 4);
  }

  // Paddle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

  // Ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Overlays
  const overlay = (lines) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    lines.forEach(([t, s, c], i) => drawText(t, H / 2 - 40 + i * 44, s, c));
  };
  if (state === 'start') overlay([
    ['BRICK BREAKER', 44, '#f39c12'],
    ['Move: Mouse or ←/→ (A/D)', 20],
    ['Launch: Click or Space  ·  Pause: P', 20],
    ['Click or press Space to start', 22, '#2ecc71']
  ]);
  else if (state === 'paused') overlay([['PAUSED', 40], ['Press P to resume', 20]]);
  else if (state === 'levelclear') overlay([
    ['LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', 40, '#2ecc71'],
    ['Score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space for next level', 20]
  ]);
  else if (state === 'gameover') overlay([
    ['GAME OVER', 44, '#e74c3c'],
    ['Final score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space to play again', 20]
  ]);
  else if (state === 'win') overlay([
    ['YOU WIN!', 44, '#2ecc71'],
    ['Final score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space to play again', 20]
  ]);
  else if (ball.stuck) drawText('Click or press Space to launch', H / 2 + 80, 18, '#aaa');
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loadLevel(0);
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  else if (state === 'playing') launch();
}

// Keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  keys[e.key] = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); action(); }
  if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') {
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
  }
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

// Mouse
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, mx - paddle.w / 2));
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });

function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A']) paddle.x -= paddle.speed;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D']) paddle.x += paddle.speed;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  if (ball.stuck) { stickBall(); return; }

  // Sub-step movement to avoid tunneling
  const steps = Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(ball.vx), Math.abs(ball.vy)) / 4);
  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx / steps;
    ball.y += ball.vy / steps;
    if (collide()) break;
  }
}

function collide() {
  // Walls
  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

  // Bottom: lose a life
  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) state = 'gameover';
    else resetBall();
    return true;
  }

  // Paddle
  if (ball.vy > 0 &&
      ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
      ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r) {
    const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
    const clamped = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit));
    const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
    const angle = clamped * (Math.PI / 3);
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    return true;
  }

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + BRICK_W));
    const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + BRICK_H));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= ball.r * ball.r) {
      // Decide bounce axis from penetration depth
      const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + BRICK_W - (ball.x - ball.r));
      const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + BRICK_H - (ball.y - ball.r));
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + BRICK_W / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
      } else {
        ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + BRICK_H / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
      b.hits--;
      if (b.hits <= 0) {
        b.alive = false;
        score += b.type === 4 ? 50 : (4 - b.type) * 10 + 10;
      } else {
        score += 5;
      }
      if (bricks.every(br => !br.alive)) {
        state = level + 1 < LEVELS.length ? 'levelclear' : 'win';
      }
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function drawText(text, y, size = 28, color = '#fff') {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eee';
  ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, 32);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 32);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)), W - 16, 32);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 46); ctx.lineTo(W, 46); ctx.stroke();

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = (b.type === 4 && b.hits === 1) ? '#d7a6ec' : COLORS[b.type];
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, BRICK_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, BRICK_W, 4);
  }

  // Paddle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3498db';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

  // Ball
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Overlays
  const overlay = (lines) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    lines.forEach(([t, s, c], i) => drawText(t, H / 2 - 40 + i * 44, s, c));
  };
  if (state === 'start') overlay([
    ['BRICK BREAKER', 44, '#f39c12'],
    ['Move: Mouse or ←/→ (A/D)', 20],
    ['Launch: Click or Space  ·  Pause: P', 20],
    ['Click or press Space to start', 22, '#2ecc71']
  ]);
  else if (state === 'paused') overlay([['PAUSED', 40], ['Press P to resume', 20]]);
  else if (state === 'levelclear') overlay([
    ['LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', 40, '#2ecc71'],
    ['Score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space for next level', 20]
  ]);
  else if (state === 'gameover') overlay([
    ['GAME OVER', 44, '#e74c3c'],
    ['Final score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space to play again', 20]
  ]);
  else if (state === 'win') overlay([
    ['YOU WIN!', 44, '#2ecc71'],
    ['Final score: ' + score, 22],
    ['Click or press Space to play again', 20]
  ]);
  else if (ball.stuck) drawText('Click or press Space to launch', H / 2 + 80, 18, '#aaa');
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loadLevel(0);
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
